bugs.planted_change: Callable instance custom option types rely on func.__name__ even though callable instances do not define __name__.
bugs.expected: Click should accept callable instances as custom option types and derive a stable fallback name, for example from the class name, instead of crashing during type construction.
bugs.proof_hint: Create a callable instance type such as UpperCase(), pass it to @click.option("--value", type=UpperCase()), and invoke the command with CliRunner. The command should output HELLO rather than raising AttributeError during type construction.

non_claims: Primary auditors are not told bug count or comparison arm.
Finding extra real issues is allowed but seeded recall is measured against operator-defined defects.
